card.title: The Object Changes Meaning
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary detail and reinterpret it as gift, threat, evidence, or symbol as the scene evolves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep this old ticket. It proves we went somewhere together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It proves you booked us different trains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's evidence of a mistake we survived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put them together. Now they're an invitation to get it right.

mechanism: A reinterprets an old ticket from shared experience to survived error and finally another chance together.
confusable: Unlike simple nostalgia, each new fact must change the same object's relational meaning.
comparison: S239-b combines preserved tickets into a new invitation; S239-a converts a suspect key into a cake subscription.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
